handoff: Approve, no blocking findings: SECURITY.md covers the checklist the issue asks for, SKILL.md wires it into the Standards axis, REVIEW.md lists the five sensitive paths; test and typecheck green. Minor: the starter REVIEW.md from norn init has no Sensitive paths section.

findings.title: Starter REVIEW.md does not offer a Sensitive paths section
findings.detail:
norn init writes packages/cli/assets/REVIEW.md into repos that have none. It lists Ignore, What counts as failure here and Do not report, but no Sensitive paths section, so a repo using the shipped skill has no hint that the security checklist exists or how to turn it on. The issue only asks for the skill and this repo's REVIEW.md, so this is not a spec gap.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: In a follow-up, add an empty or commented `## Sensitive paths` section to the starter template that names what belongs there.
